title: Niche Trend & Format Scan
description: Scan top Reels in the client's niche hashtags to extract the formats and hooks winning right now, and deliver a trend brief with ready-to-use content angles.

inputs.label: Client niche (e.g. fitness studios, skincare, SaaS)

nodes.title: Collect top Reels from niche hashtags
nodes.detail: On Instagram, explore each input hashtag and collect 12–15 top-performing Reels combined. For each Reel record: URL, account, likes and comments, first caption line (the hook), caption structure, format type (talking head / text-overlay list / before-after / POV / tutorial etc.), and the audio name shown. Read on-screen text only — no screenshots.
nodes.acceptance: 12+ Reels from different accounts captured with URL, hook, and format type.

subtasks.title: Tag each Reel's format type
subtasks.purpose: One format label per Reel for pattern analysis

outputScope.name: reels
outputScope.description: Per-Reel url, account, likes, comments, hook, format, audio

nodes.title: Verify scan coverage
nodes.detail: Check that reels has 12+ entries, every entry has a non-empty url, hook, and format, and no single account appears more than 3 times.

nodes.title: Write the trend brief
nodes.detail: Group the Reels by format and write a markdown trend brief: (1) the top 5 dominant formats this scan with a representative example each, (2) recurring hook types with the actual hook lines quoted, (3) five content ideas the team can produce for this niche now (format + hook + topic combos). Save to the workflow output folder.
nodes.acceptance: Top-5 formats, hook types, and five content ideas sections are all filled.

subtasks.title: Group and rank formats
subtasks.purpose: Dominant formats by frequency and engagement

subtasks.title: Draft five applied ideas
subtasks.purpose: Niche × format × hook combinations ready to brief

outputScope.name: sections_written
outputScope.description: Section titles written to the brief
